name: phalange-restaurant-inspections
description: Official restaurant health-inspection records for 9 US metros: compliance lookup by name + address, venue search, inspection detail, and risk summaries.
long_description: Gives agents access to official restaurant health-inspection records served by eat.phalangeai.com (Boston, New York City, Chicago, Austin, Los Angeles County, Santa Clara County, Las Vegas / Clark County, Miami-Dade, Cambridge MA), from city/county open-data feeds refreshed daily. The headline tool is a compliance lookup that answers with a coverage_status (not_covered means no data, never 'clean'), match confidence, latest result, violation and critical-violation counts, closure status, and the official source URL.

tools.name: restaurant_compliance_lookup
tools.description: Compliance lookup by business name + address: coverage status, match confidence, latest inspection, critical violations, closure status

tools.name: restaurant_search
tools.description: Search restaurant venues in one metro by name

tools.name: restaurant_venue_detail
tools.description: One venue's inspection history and latest violation lines

tools.name: restaurant_risk_summary
tools.description: Per-metro inspection/failure aggregates for a time window
